items.source: The RedisCacheWriter may be shared by multiple cache implementations and is responsible for reading/writing binary data from/to Redis. The implementation honors potential cache lock flags that might be set.
items.translation: RedisCacheWriter 可由多个缓存实现共享，负责从 Redis 读取/写入二进制数据。该实现会尊重可能设置的缓存锁标志。

items.source: If possible (and configured for locking), implementations should ensure that the loading operation is synchronized so that the specified valueLoader is only called once in case of concurrent access on the same key.
items.translation: 如果可能（且已配置为支持锁定），实现应确保加载操作是同步的，以便在并发访问同一键的情况下，指定的 `valueLoader` 仅被调用一次。

items.source:
The main factor for whether the retrieve operation can be supported will primarily be determined by the
Redis driver in use at runtime.
items.translation: 检索操作是否得到支持，主要取决于运行时所使用的 Redis 驱动。

items.source: RedisCacheWriter provides low-level access to Redis commands (SET, SETNX, GET, EXPIRE,...) used for caching.
items.translation: RedisCacheWriter 提供了对用于缓存的 Redis 命令（SET, SETNX, GET, EXPIRE,...）的低级访问。
